root_cause.text: The `squashfs_read_metadata` function in the Squashfs subsystem lacks validation for the metadata block offset, allowing negative or out-of-range values from corrupted index data to propagate and cause out-of-bounds memory access.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description attributes the "general protection fault" to a "negative metadata block offset" caused by a "corrupted index look-up table," and the patch introduces a range check `if (unlikely(*offset < 0 || *offset >= SQUASHFS_METADATA_SIZE))` in `squashfs_read_metadata` to prevent this.
